scope: Synthetic, manually primed Retail transitions; 32 ticks per case.

reports.scope:
Compare bounded, manually primed Retail cross-bank tracker transitions.

One tracker/mixer tick precedes a bank/order switch. A fresh source and target
context are used per case. Events, reachability, device timing, multiball and
other game services are not modeled. No original media or PCM is in the report.
